derivation:
by
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← PresentedGroup.closure_range_of, MonoidHom.map_closure, ← range_comp]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, macbeathHom_of, Subtype.range_coe]
explanation: Mathlib proves that the closure of the canonical generators of any presented group is ⊤. Mapping that equality through `macbeathHom` gives the closure of the images of those generators; `macbeathHom_of` identifies those images with `macbeathGenerators G U`.
